title: Overwhelming evidence of subsidence on the Atlantic floor along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge

tellings.quote: it's right there. There is overwhelming evidence of major subsidance on the floor the Atlant the floor of the Atlantic Ocean, particularly concentrated along the mid-Atlantic ridge.

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher of ancient catastrophes, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that there is overwhelming evidence the floor of the Atlantic Ocean sank in a big way, mostly along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, an underwater mountain chain running down the middle of the ocean. He ties this to around 9600 BC, the end of a sudden cold spell at the close of the last ice age, and to the ancient Greek writer Plato, whose dialogues tell of the lost island of Atlantis. If true, it would back the idea that Atlantis really sank.
